company: Master Power Systems Limited (MPSL) Business Unit: MEP EPC Reports To: COO / MD Location: Nairobi, Kenya Coverage: Kenya, Uganda & Rwanda Travel: Regular travel to project sites and client offices Employment Type: Full-Time Role Purpose Master Power Systems Limited (MPSL) is seeking an experienced Head of MEP Business to lead the growth, delivery and financial performance of its MEP EPC business across Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda. The role owns the full commercial cycle — from business development, tendering and bid selection through project execution, final accounts and cash collection . The successful candidate will be accountable for revenue, EBITDA, margins, working capital and overall business performance. This is a senior leadership role requiring strong commercial judgement, technical MEP expertise, project leadership and client management capability . Key Responsibilities 1. Business Growth & Strategy Develop and execute the MEP business growth strategy across Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda. Build and manage a qualified pipeline across residential, hospitality, retail, commercial, warehousing and institutional projects. Develop senior relationships with developers, main contractors, consultants and key clients. Identify new markets, segments and delivery opportunities. 2. Business Development, Tendering & Estimation Lead bid/no-bid decisions based on commercial viability, contract risk, client payment history, capacity and expected margins. Oversee technical and commercial tender preparation, including BOQs, cost build-ups, pricing and risk assessment. Review and approve estimates before submission. Lead post-tender negotiations and commercial discussions through to award. 3. Project Delivery & Portfolio Management Allocate awarded projects across Project Management Cluster Heads based on capacity and technical fit. Ensure projects have clear budgets, programmes, resource plans and cost-to-complete forecasts. Monitor project performance against revenue, cost, programme and cash targets . Intervene early where projects are trending outside agreed thresholds. Drive successful completion, handover, final accounts and claims/variations. 4. P&L, Cost & Cash Management Own the EBITDA and financial performance of the MEP Business Unit. Control material, labour and supervision costs against approved thresholds. Drive value engineering and cost optimisation without compromising technical standards. Ensure timely valuations, invoicing and collection of certified amounts. Protect the company's commercial position on payment terms, variations, claims and contractual exposure. 5. Procurement, Quality & Compliance Ensure accurate material planning and procurement aligned with project requirements. Support technical evaluation and negotiation of MEP suppliers and subcontractors. Enforce quality, HSE and regulatory standards across projects. Ensure compliance with statutory and client requirements in each country. 6. Leadership & Governance Build and develop the MEP organisation and leadership structure. Set performance objectives and hold Cluster Heads accountable for results. Develop technical and commercial capability across the business. Provide monthly reporting to the COO / MD covering pipeline, revenue, EBITDA, costs, collections, manpower, HSE and key risks. Escalate significant commercial, legal or operational risks promptly. Qualifications & Experience Required: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , or equivalent. Minimum 15 years' experience in MEP contracting , including senior responsibility for a multi-project portfolio. Proven experience delivering mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) projects . Strong track record across residential, hospitality, retail, commercial and/or warehousing developments. Demonstrated experience in the East African market , working with developers, main contractors and consultants. Proven record of securing significant MEP orders through tender strategy and commercial negotiation. Experience with P&L/EBITDA accountability, budgeting, cost control, margin management and cash collection . Strong understanding of MEP project execution, commercial management and contracts. Willingness to travel across Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda. Preferred: Registration with EBK or equivalent professional body. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Project Management/Business. Experience with ERP-based project/cost control systems. Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, MS Project or Primavera. Experience with institutional, healthcare or large-scale projects. Core Competencies Strong commercial and strategic judgement MEP technical depth and credibility Portfolio and project leadership P&L, cost and cash discipline Business development and negotiation Strong client and stakeholder management Integrity, governance and accountability

The successful candidate will be responsible for winning the right projects at the right commercial terms and ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, to quality and safety standards. Build and manage a qualified pipeline across utilities, transmission companies, IPPs, development finance/donor programmes and C&I clients. Develop senior relationships with utilities, regulators, consultants, DFIs, EPC partners and key clients. Identify new markets, partnerships, consortiums and JV opportunities. Represent MPSL in client meetings, industry forums, pre-bid meetings and site visits. 2. Tendering & Commercial Management Lead bid/no-bid decisions based on technical feasibility, contract risk, resources, payment terms and expected margins. Direct technical and commercial tender preparation, including specifications, BOQs, estimates, pricing and qualifications. Lead post-tender clarifications and commercial negotiations through contract award. Own Business Unit performance across order intake, revenue, gross margin, working capital and cash collection . 3. Project Delivery Provide portfolio-level leadership for Solar and Substation projects, including current and future projects. Lead Project Managers, engineers and site teams to deliver projects within approved budgets and programmes. Monitor physical and financial progress, cost-to-complete, resources and project risks. Drive mobilisation, construction, testing, commissioning, handover and final account closure. Proactively address delays, cost overruns, resource constraints and contractual risks. 4. Contracts, Claims & Cost Control Ensure accurate project budgets, valuations, progress claims and cost forecasts. Identify and pursue variations, extensions of time and contractual claims. Protect the company's position on payment terms, retention, performance security, liquidated damages and other contractual exposures. Support procurement through accurate material requirements, technical specifications and vendor evaluations. 5. Quality, HSE & Compliance Ensure projects meet client specifications, utility standards and applicable industry codes. Enforce MPSL health, safety and environmental standards across all sites. Ensure compliance with regulatory, licensing and client/lender ESG requirements across operating countries. 6. Leadership & Reporting Build and lead a strong technical and commercial Business Unit team. Set clear objectives, manage performance and develop team capability. Minimum 15 years' experience in EPC delivery of HV substations and transmission lines , including senior responsibility for the full project lifecycle. Proven track record working with East African utilities and donor-funded programmes , such as KETRACO, KPLC, UETCL, REA, TANESCO or equivalent. Proven ability to secure EPC orders , lead tender strategy and negotiate contracts through award. Strong P&L/commercial accountability , including margin management, cost-to-complete forecasting and cash performance. Strong knowledge of contracts, variations, claims and FIDIC or equivalent forms . Experience leading multidisciplinary technical, commercial and project teams. Willingness to travel across East Africa; valid passport and ability to obtain work permits. SYSTEMS & TOOLS Experience with ERP-based project controls, MS Project or Primavera and AutoCAD . Knowledge of PLS-CADD or PVsyst is an advantage. CORE COMPETENCIES We are looking for a leader with: Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk-adjusted returns. Proven delivery ownership and project execution discipline. Deep technical understanding of solar, substations and EPC environments. Strong contractual and claims management capability. Leadership maturity and ability to hold teams accountable. Credibility with utilities, clients, consultants and senior stakeholders. High integrity and commitment to governance.
